title: TrailGenic Route-Aware Heart-Rate Drift Observations

notes: Interpretation considers ascent, descent, route structure, terrain, pace, altitude, heat, and segmented recordings.
Lower downhill heart rate is not automatically classified as favorable drift.
The value is a descriptive route-structured observation, not a validated cardiac-efficiency, readiness, or fatigue score.

aggregate_observation.interpretation: Negative values were common in this n-of-1 series. The distribution alone does not identify mechanism.

active.statement: Twenty-eight of 34 observations were negative and the median was -1.00%.

withdrawn.reason: The Wheeler Peak observation did not validate fatigue as the mechanism for positive drift.

evidence_boundary: N-of-1 observational data. No population, causal, diagnostic, readiness, fatigue, or clinical claim.
